title: Block an unsafe algorithm go-live
notice: Demo with sample data only. It is not connected to your organization's data, and it should not be.
question: Is anything about to go live that shouldn't?

answer.question: Is anything about to go live that shouldn't?
answer.answer:
Yes — **ALGO-MOM-05**, the new momentum algo, is pre-deployment but only 2 of 4 required MiFID II (RTS 6) docs are done:

- ✅ Kill switch test, audit trail
- ❌ Pre-trade testing (12-month backtest w/ volatility scenarios) — missing
- ❌ Stress scenarios — missing

It needs Quant sign-off and a completed compliance-register filing before it should go live, deadline end of week. Everything else live (VWAP, IS, POV, Dark Aggregator) is fully documented.

This is an at-risk flag for your review, not a go/no-go verdict — the actual deployment decision stays with Quant/Compliance.
